caption: The video captures an indoor birthday gathering centered on a floral plate held close to the camera, piled with large chocolate-chip cookies rimmed in multicolored sprinkles. Long colored candles are stuck into the cookies, each burning with an open flame that flickers and reshapes continuously while every wick stays lit. Behind the plate a man in a white T-shirt sits at a dark wooden table at the left, a boy in a blue shirt leans onto the tabletop in the middle, and a girl in a gray shirt faces the candles, with a child in red partly visible behind her. A bright multi-pane window, a framed wall sign, and a basket on a chair fill the background. The handheld framing drifts, tilting the plate and sliding the seated figures across the view. The man at left opens and closes his mouth as if talking or singing, his head shifting. The girl turns toward the cookies and smiles as the child in red leans into frame. The boy in blue stays propped on the table with small posture changes.
